_comment: 動作絵(動詞)の生成リスト。画像を images/action/<id>.png に生成・最適化したあと `node scripts/merge-pending.mjs` で cards.json に取り込む。取り込まれた項目はこのファイルから自動で消える。
prompt_template: {english_prompt}, a single adult person performing the action, full body visible, clear and simple pose, centered on a pure white background, flat illustration style. Style: clean, educational illustration for speech therapy materials, the action must be recognizable at a glance. Colors: soft, natural. Composition: only the person and the object needed for the action, no other background elements, no text, no logos. Aspect ratio: 1:1.

cards.english_prompt: a person eating a bowl of rice with chopsticks, sitting at a table
a person drinking water from a glass, glass raised to the mouth
a person sleeping in a bed with eyes closed, head on a pillow, blanket pulled up
a person walking calmly, side view, one foot forward, arms swinging naturally
a person running fast, side view, both feet off the ground, arms pumping
a person sitting on a simple chair, hands on knees, relaxed
a person standing up from a chair, mid-motion, knees slightly bent, hands pushing on the seat
a person reading an open book held in both hands, looking down at the pages
a person writing on paper with a pencil at a desk
a person laughing happily with a big open smile, one hand near the mouth
a person crying with visible tears, wiping eyes with one hand
a person washing hands under running water at a sink
a person cutting a carrot with a kitchen knife on a cutting board
a person throwing a ball, arm extended forward, ball in the air
a person jumping straight up with both feet off the ground, arms raised
a person swimming freestyle in blue water, head turned to breathe
a person singing with mouth open, holding a microphone, small music notes nearby
a person brushing teeth with a toothbrush, toothbrush in the mouth
a person putting on a jacket, one arm already in the sleeve, the other arm reaching back
a person opening a door by the handle, door half open
